options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Determines what is required to complete the game.

Campaign Complete: Finish both final missions.
Maps Conquered: Conquer a certain number of maps (see maps_to_win).
Full Conquest: Conquer all 12 maps (10 regular + 2 final missions).
All Weapons: Collect every shuffled weapon item. Only valid with
  weapon_shuffle set to categories or individual.

options.name: Maps to Win
options.doc: Number of maps that must be conquered to win (only used when Goal is 'Maps Conquered').

options.name: Starting Rank
options.doc:
Number of Squadmate Slots pre-collected at start. Each slot = +1 rank = bigger squad.
0 = Private (default start).

options.name: Starting Map
options.doc:
Which campaign map the player starts on. The matching map key is precollected.
Choices are limited to the first three campaign maps.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: Percentage chance that a filler item is replaced by a trap.

options.name: Trap Severity
options.doc:
Controls the intensity of trap effects.

Mild: Short durations (30s), reduced impact.
Medium: Standard values (default).
Harsh: Long durations (150s), maximum impact.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle l'intensité des effets des pièges.

Mild: Courtes durées (30 s), impact réduit.
Medium: Valeurs standard (par défaut).
Harsh: Longues durées (150s), impact maximal.

options.name: Weapon Shuffle
options.doc:
Controls how weapons are shuffled into the item pool.

None: Weapons are unlocked by rank as in vanilla. No weapon items in the pool.
Categories: 9 weapon category items (Assault Rifles, Machineguns, etc.).
  Receiving a category unlocks all weapons of that type.
Individual: Each weapon is its own item (~196 items).
  Maximum randomization.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle la façon dont les armes sont mélangées dans la réserve d'articles.

None: Les armes sont déverrouillées par rang comme dans la vanille. Pas d'armes dans la piscine.
Categories: 9 articles de la catégorie armes (coupes, mitrailleuses, etc.).
  La réception d'une catégorie débloque toutes les armes de ce type.
Individual: Chaque arme est son propre article (~196 articles).
  Randomisation maximale.

options.name: Base Capture Mode
options.doc:
Controls how base captures generate location checks.

Progressive: "Captured N bases on Map X" milestones. Number controlled by
  base_captures_per_map.
Individual: Each named base is its own check (~130 locations total).
  Maximum randomization.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle comment les captures de base génèrent des vérifications de localisation.

Progressive: « Captured N bases on Map X » jalons. Numéro contrôlé par base captures per map.
Individual: Chaque base nommée est son propre chèque (~130 emplacements au total).
  Randomisation maximale.

options.name: Base Captures Per Map
options.doc:
Number of progressive capture milestones per map (only used when
Base Capture Mode is 'Progressive').
Example: 3 means checks at "Captured 1/3 bases", "Captured 2/3 bases",
"Captured 3/3 bases" for each map.

options.name: Include Side Missions
options.doc:
Whether side missions are included as locations (one per map).
Turning this off reduces the total location count.

options.name: Shuffle Radio Calls
options.doc: Whether radio calls are shuffled into the item pool instead of being unlocked by rank.

options.name: Grenade Shuffle
options.doc:
Controls how vanilla grenades (hand grenade, stun grenade, event grenades)
are handled.

None: Available freely as in vanilla. No grenade items in the pool.
Grouped: One "Vanilla Grenades" item unlocks all grenades at once.
Individual: Each grenade is its own item (4 items).
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle la façon dont les grenades à vanille (grenade à main, grenade à stun, grenades événementielles)
sont manipulés.

None: Disponible gratuitement comme dans la vanille. Pas de grenade dans la piscine.
Grouped: Un article "Vanilla Grenades" déverrouille toutes les grenades en même temps.
Individual: Chaque grenade est son propre article (4 articles).

options.name: Vest Shuffle
options.doc:
Controls how vanilla vests (exo suit, navy vest, camo vest) are handled.

None: Available freely as in vanilla. No vest items in the pool.
Grouped: One "Vanilla Vests" item unlocks all vests at once.
Individual: Each vest is its own item (3 items).
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle la manipulation des gilets de vanille (vêtement exo, gilet marine, gilet camo).

None: Disponible gratuitement comme dans la vanille. Pas de gilet dans la piscine.
Grouped: Un article "Vanilla Vests" déverrouille tous les gilets à la fois.
Individual: Chaque gilet est son propre article (3 articles).

options.name: Costume Shuffle
options.doc:
Controls how cosmetic costumes are handled (purely visual, no gameplay impact).

None: Available freely as in vanilla. No costume items in the pool.
Grouped: One "Costumes Pack" item unlocks all 12 costumes at once.
Individual: Each costume is its own item (12 items).
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle la façon dont les costumes cosmétiques sont manipulés (purement visuelle, aucun impact de gameplay).

None: Disponible gratuitement comme dans la vanille. Pas de costume dans la piscine.
Grouped: Un article "Costumes Pack" déverrouille les 12 costumes à la fois.
Individual: Chaque costume est son propre article (12 articles).

options.name: Shuffle Weapon Deliveries
options.doc:
Whether delivering 5 enemy weapons to the armory creates location checks.
Each of the 15 deliverable weapons becomes its own check.

options.name: Shuffle Briefcases & Laptops
options.doc:
Whether delivering briefcases and laptops to the armory creates location checks.
8 briefcase deliveries + 6 laptop deliveries = 14 checks.

options.name: RP Shop
options.doc:
Spend in-game RP to purchase Archipelago checks via /apbuy command.
Each map gets a number of purchasable checks (see rp_shop_per_map).

options.name: RP Shop Per Map
options.doc: Number of RP Shop checks available per map (only used when RP Shop is enabled).

options.name: RP Shop Cost
options.doc: RP cost for each shop purchase.

options.name: Start with Grenades
options.doc:
Start with all vanilla grenades already unlocked.
Only relevant when Grenade Shuffle is not None.

options.name: Start with Vests
options.doc:
Start with all vanilla vests already unlocked.
Only relevant when Vest Shuffle is not None.

options.name: Start with Costumes
options.doc:
Start with all vanilla costumes already unlocked.
Only relevant when Costume Shuffle is not None.

options.name: Start with Radio
options.doc:
Start with the Radio master item already unlocked.
Only relevant when Shuffle Radio Calls is enabled.

options.name: Start with Basic Weapons
options.doc:
Start with basic weapon access. In categories mode, precollects
Assault Rifles and Pistols. In individual mode, precollects one
assault rifle and one pistol. No effect with weapon_shuffle=none.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled Death Link dies. When someone else dies, you die.

options.name: Death Link Mode
options.doc:
What happens when you receive a death link from another player.

Kill: You die instantly (default).
Random Trap: A random trap is applied instead of killing you.
